entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • PropertyChangedEventArgs should have a nice DebuggerDisplay #136608
  • Test Failure: System.IO.Tests.FileStream_Dispose.DerivedFileStreamDisposeSuppressesStrategyFinalization* #136604
  • .NET apps abort in ".NET BGC" / ".NET TP Worker" threads (GPF in libc.so.6 +0x289a2) on Ubuntu 26.04 hosts, kernel 7.0.0-34 (Kubernetes/containerd) #136603
  • [mono][wasm] References in a large `static readonly` struct are not kept valid across a GC (`browser-wasm`) #136602
  • Regex: negated character class loop followed by \b incorrectly made atomic #136601
  • MemoryMappedFile (Windows): failed MEM_COMMIT is ignored, accessor over reserved memory crashes the process #136599
  • [mono] JIT inline access to [ThreadStatic] fields doesn't run the class constructor #136592
  • System.Text.Json 11: CastingConverter no longer forwards ReadAsPropertyName/WriteAsPropertyName to a base-typed converter (JsonConverter<Enum> dictionary keys regress from .NET 10) #136588
  • [Mono][ARM64] Suspected missing publication/acquire ordering in delegate trampoline cache #136583
  • [Mono][ARM64] JIT thunk target literals can be insufficiently aligned for concurrent updates #136582
  • [Mono][Interpreter] Reverse P/Invoke / [UnmanagedCallersOnly] returning bool or char does not zero-extend return register on Apple ARM64 #136578
  • FileSystemWatcher on macOS raises no Error when FSEvents drops events: the flags arrive on the watched folder's own path, which is skipped first #136577
  • Extend TypeMapAssemblyTarget scanning to defining assembly of TTypeMapGroup #136575
  • [API Proposal][AOT]: Make Assembly.GetSatelliteAssembly work in AOT mode #136573
  • SIGILL (rdvl) #136572
  • [NativeAOT] iOS 27 GC reports OOM while physical memory remains, after a segment is placed in the high VA window #136569
  • ILLink does not retain external TypeMap entries for castclass targets #136568
  • DynamicallyAccessedMembersAnalyzer: GetFlags walks the base-type and interface chain on every call with no cache #136567
  • new DirectoryEntry() with empty path and AuthenticationTypes.SecureSocketsLayer has LDAP traffic over 389 port #136565
  • Test failure: System.Net.Security.Tests.TlsSessionTests.ServerSession_ExternalValidation_ConcurrentSessionsPreserveOwnCertificateChain #136560
  • JIT: (bug) Bounds check for `b[i - 1]` not eliminated once RangeCheck accounts for underflow of `i - 1` on a loop IV #136559
